summary: Mr. Arking discusses the customs and sources regarding the special foods served on the night of Rosh Hashanah. He examines the order of the foods, the laws of berachot for the fruits, and the background of various community traditions.
questions: On which nights of Rosh Hashanah are the special foods served?
What are the five foods listed in the Gemara?
Why do some authorities give precedence to dates over pomegranates?
When should the berakha of Ha'etz be recited on the fruits?
What is the community custom regarding dipping the apple and bread?
